blocks.task_summary: Find the smallest value of t for which the particle is at rest, i.e. solve v(t) = t sin t - 3 = 0 on 0 <= t <= 10 and select the smallest root.
method_path: Recognise particle at rest implies v(t) = 0
Solve t sin t - 3 = 0 on [0, 10] using GDC
Identify smallest positive root t approx 6.74

evidence.basis: recognising v = 0 (M1); t = 6.74416... = 6.74 (sec) A1; Note: Do not award A1 if additional values are given.

blocks.task_summary: Find the total distance travelled by evaluating the definite integral of |v(t)| from 0 to 10, where v(t) = t sin t - 3, using GDC integration.
method_path: Recognise total distance = integral from 0 to 10 of |v(t)| dt
Evaluate integral of |t sin t - 3| from 0 to 10 using GDC
accepted_alternatives: Split integral at sign changes: negative integral from 0 to 6.744 of v(t) dt + integral from 6.744 to 9.088 of v(t) dt - integral from 9.088 to 10 of v(t) dt, evaluated by GDC

evidence.basis: integral of |v(t)| dt OR split integral with roots 6.744... and 9.088... (A1); = 37.0968... = 37.1 (m) A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the acceleration at t = 7 by differentiating v(t) = t sin t - 3 and evaluating v'(7).
method_path: Differentiate v(t) = t sin t - 3 or use GDC derivative
accepted_alternatives: Analytic differentiation: v'(t) = sin t + t cos t, then substitute t = 7

evidence.basis: recognising acceleration at t = 7 is given by v'(7) (M1); acceleration = 5.93430... = 5.93 (ms^-2) A1
